key_insight: Fine-tuning on explicit quantum simulation traces can teach LLMs genuine quantum reasoning, with SFT excelling on accuracy and SFT+GRPO improving scalability to larger qubit systems.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a practical path to build domain-specific AI assistants for quantum hardware and circuit analysis that can reason over gate sequences rather than just match patterns.
method: Supervised Fine-Tuning on gate-by-gate state-vector simulation traces
Two-stage SFT + GRPO using verifiable rewards
Evaluate by predicting measurement probability distributions from quantum gate sequences
evidence_signal: Across the abstracted evaluation, SFT achieved near-perfect in-distribution and gate-count extrapolation accuracy, while SFT+GRPO generalized better to larger qubit systems and both outperformed the base model and GPT-OSS-120B.
watch_item: GRPO improves larger-system generalization but appears to reduce in-distribution precision, so the training objective may need balancing to avoid trading accuracy for scalability.
paper_title: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Quantum Reasoning
